program.name: Kickboxing 35
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of kickboxing: bouts, then a kick circuit or strength.
program.about: Kickboxing for about half an hour. Each day opens with bouts of kicks, knees and punches, then a circuit of kicks and conditioning one day and straight sets of strength the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Bouts & kick circuit / bouts & strength, 35 minutes
